library.name: APALCDGUI
library.author: APADevices <kecup@vazac.eu>
library.sentence: Parallel 20x4 LCD menu system with dual rotary encoders for APA Devices water treatment automation
library.paragraph: Non-blocking 11-state UI library for Arduino-compatible boards (AVR, ESP32, ESP8266, STM32). Drives a 4-bit parallel LiquidCrystal display with two quadrature encoders, a two-tier alert system, PWM backlight with EEPROM persistence, optional DS3231 RTC modal, inline timer schedule screen (up to 3 on/off slots, auto-saved to EEPROM), and a factory-function API for menu screens with 1-3 fields
